relations.rationale: Booking a hall has no bearing on whether Milo, Otto, and Kira shared a birthday cake.
Jude showing up last is consistent with and explained by rushing after a seminar, making the detail about being out of breath more plausible.
Arriving last and then still talking about the seminar are compatible and the former sets up the context for the latter.
Jude arriving last after rushing is consistent with him then describing a seminar argument that ran long, supporting that claim's plausibility.
Being out of breath from rushing after a seminar supports the idea that Jude was still talking about that seminar.
Milo picking seats near the window is a separate action from arranging chairs for viewing displays; not clearly connected.
Milo's seat choice has no logical bearing on the order in which Otto and Kira signed a sheet.
Milo arranging chairs and Milo nodding approvingly are separate actions without a logical dependency.
Being in the same class as Kira supports the plausibility that Otto and Kira often walk together afterward.
Otto being in the same class as Kira says nothing about whether Kira is in the same class as Jude.
Otto's class relation to Kira has no bearing on Jude's account of a seminar argument.
Otto being in the same class as Kira doesn't determine whether Otto is in the same class as Jude.
Otto's class relation with Kira has no bearing on Milo passing around a sign-up sheet.
Class relation between Otto and Kira has no bearing on relative ages of Milo and Otto.
Noor choosing a mystery novel could be the suggestion that Milo nodded approvingly at, making it more plausible.
Noor's book choice is unrelated to whether Kira and Jude share a class.
Noor's novel choice has no bearing on whether Jude was still talking about the seminar.
Milo nodding approvingly could plausibly precede or accompany him passing around a sign-up sheet, suggesting agreement with a plan.
Kira not being in the same class as Jude has no bearing on Jude's description of a seminar argument.

Kira not being in Jude's class and Otto not being in Jude's class are separate facts about different people, not directly implying each other, though both consistent with Jude being isolated from that class.
